title: Emotional Escalation Awareness (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to recognise escalation patterns that create fear or instability for children and partners.
learningOutcomes: Identify escalation patterns that impact children.
Recognise how emotional intensity affects family safety.
Understand escalation triggers in parenting contexts.

modules.title: Escalation and Fathering
modules.content: Explores how escalation affects children’s emotional security.

modules.title: Impact on Family Safety
modules.content: Shows how escalation creates fear and unpredictability.

modules.title: Safe De-escalation
modules.content: Provides tools for grounding, pausing, and safe emotional regulation.
